bizz loc.bio: Toronto rapper Bizz Loc is a fixture of the city's street-rap scene, known for blunt, high-energy records and collaborations across multiple generations of Canadian hip-hop.

blake mcgrath.bio: Mississauga-born Canadian singer, dancer and choreographer Blake McGrath built a music career alongside extensive work in television, touring and commercial dance.

bless.bio: Montréal rapper Bless is a longtime Canadian hip-hop artist and former Guru protégé whose career has included major tours, independent releases and the Platinumberg imprint.

blooom.bio: German producer and DJ Blooom, born Michael Schlechtinger, makes high-impact drum and bass built around driving tempos and festival-ready electronic production.

blynk.bio: Laval, Québec R&B artist Blynk has emerged in the francophone music scene with warm, soulful vocals, a growing solo catalogue and high-profile collaborations including Damso.

bolu ajibade.bio: Toronto-based songwriter and recording artist Bolu Ajibade makes contemporary pop and R&B-inflected music with a catalogue spanning solo releases and collaborations.

brave shores.bio: Toronto sibling duo Brave Shores, formed by Jay and Stefanie McCarrol, makes synth-pop built from layered electronics, guitars and melodic songwriting.

bundog.bio: Toronto rapper and entrepreneur Bundog, from the Driftwood area, co-founded Blue Feather Records with his brother Pressa and later developed a solo catalogue of street-oriented hip-hop.

bvlly.bio: Toronto rapper Bvlly, born Jahquar Stewart, was known for melodic street rap and vivid local storytelling before his death in 2019 at age 24.

bye parula.bio: Montréal trio Bye Parula blends indie pop, folk, funk and art-rock influences with richly arranged songwriting and a collaborative approach rooted in the city's music scene.

bocafloja.bio: Mexican interdisciplinary artist Bocafloja works across hip-hop, poetry, film, literature and photography, using his work to explore race, diaspora and the Global South.
